metadata.question: Does the snow cover in southern Siberia increase between October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about snow cover change in southern Siberia between two specific dates in October 2018. This requires: 1. **Data Selection**: MODIS snow cover products would be best for this. I'll use MOD10A1 (Terra) or MYD10A1 (Aqua) which provide daily snow cover data. 2. **Geometry**: Need to define a polygon for southern Siberia region. 3. **Dates**: October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018. 4. **Processing**: - Get snow cover images for both dates - Mask clouds/quality issues - Calculate mean snow cover percentage for each date - Compare to see if there's an increase 5. **Validation**: Check for empty collections, no valid pixels, etc. Let me use MOD10A1.006 (Terra) for consistency. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const siberia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([80, 50, 120, 55]); // Southern Siberia region const date1 = '2018-10-14'; const date2 = '2018-10-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Cover const modisSnow = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(siberia); const img1 = modisSnow.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const img2 = modisSnow.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); // Check if images exist const img1Exists = img1 ? true : false; const img2Exists = img2 ? true : false; if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log(`Images found - Oct 14: ${img1Exists}, Oct 29: ${img2Exists}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract snow cover data (NDSI_Snow_Cover band, values 0-100) const snowBand = 'NDSI_Snow_Cover'; // Mask out fill values (values > 100 are clouds/invalid) const maskSnow = function(image) { const snow = image.select(snowBand); return snow.updateMask(snow.lte(100)); }; const snow1 = maskSnow(img1); const snow2 = maskSnow(img2); // Calculate statistics const stats1 = snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: siberia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: siberia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean'); const count1 = stats1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count'); const mean2 = stats2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean'); const count2 = stats2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count'); // Get actual values const mean1Val = mean1.getInfo(); const count1Val = count1.getInfo(); const mean2Val = mean2.getInfo(); const count2Val = count2.getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 14 Snow: ${mean1Val ? mean1Val.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}% (Pixels: ${count1Val})`); console.log(`Oct 29 Snow: ${mean2Val ? mean2Val.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}% (Pixels: ${count2Val})`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1Val === 0 || count2Val === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mean1Val === null || mean2Val === null || isNaN(mean1Val) || isNaN(mean2Val) || mean1Val < 0 || mean1Val > 100 || mean2Val < 0 || mean2Val > 100) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Final Answer - Check if snow cover increased if (mean2Val > mean1Val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
